canonical_name: König edge-coloring theorem for finite bipartite multigraphs
literal_source_claim_zh: 二部图的边色数等于最大度
literal_source_claim_en: The edge chromatic number of a bipartite graph equals its maximum degree.
source_attribution: Dénes König, 1916 (catalog metadata; matched to the inspected primary paper)
canonical_statement: For every finite bipartite multigraph G, the edge chromatic number of G equals its maximum degree, with edge multiplicity counted in degree.
canonical_claim: Source-backed mathematical family only: König's finite bipartite multigraph proper-edge-coloring bound, transported to the catalog's chromatic-index equality after the maximum-degree lower bound; exact formal definitions and degenerate-case convention remain the dependent statement gate.

Pinned mathlib's convenient lineGraph and maxDegree APIs are for SimpleGraph and cannot silently replace the source multigraph.
